01Who are we?

Health is shaped by systems.

Sagework is an evidence-led advisory and design practice working across biology, environment and behaviour.

Sagework brings these forces into one evidence-led framework. We translate research into practical strategy, system design and implementation for organisations, institutions and leaders addressing complex human challenges.

02Why are we here?

Modern systems are changing faster than human biology

Sagework examines this as the Human Adaptation Gap: the distance between what modern systems demand from people and what human biology needs to function well.

Many health solutions focus on the individual after the effects appear. Sagework begins with the system itself.

03A journey through the gut

Biology responds to conditions.

Environments influence behaviour.

Behaviour reinforces outcomes.

Sustainable change requires all three to be considered together.

04What do we bring to you?

Three domains. One human system.

Biology, environment and behaviour are not separate variables. They are connected conditions within one human system.

What is happening within us.

We use evidence from clinical nutrition, gut microbiome research and preventive health to understand the biological factors influencing health and performance.

Nutrition · the gut microbiome · metabolism · sleep · stress physiology · circadian rhythms · preventive health

05The Five Senses

The body's interface with the world

The senses are a primary pathway through which the environment becomes biological information.

Explore the Five Senses

Sight · Light that supports the activity

—%

Light treated as a timed biological input

An international expert consensus published in PLOS Biology provides separate recommendations for daytime, evening and night-time light exposure in healthy adults. It supports treating light as a timed biological input.

Source: PLOS Biology (journals.plos.org)

07SAGE OS

A disciplined framework from diagnosis to action

Step 1 of 4

Observe the system

Examine the people, purpose, setting, experience and conditions shaping everyday life.

What will you get by working with us?

The objective is not more activity. It is a clearer understanding of the system, better decisions and interventions that can hold under real operating conditions.

Possible outputs

A project brief and design recommendations

A programme or environment strategy

An implementation roadmap

A current-state assessment and gap analysis

A prioritised action plan

Decision briefs and evidence reviews

Workshops, talks and leadership briefings

A board briefing or strategic review

Scope and deliverables are agreed at the outset of each engagement.

09Meet Dr Shruti Pai

How do we build systems that genuinely help people live and work better?

Dr Shruti Pai is a business leader, clinical nutrition scientist, gut microbiome researcher and human systems designer. Her work brings together more than two decades of experience across business, healthcare, education, food systems, research and environmental design.
